resources.string: Install Awan TV from this phone in a few minutes, no computer needed. First, four steps on the TV with its remote. If Developer options are already on, go to step 3.
TV menus are shown in Arabic and English; some TVs word them a little differently
On older Android TVs: Settings › Device Preferences › About, then Build.
Press OK on it 7 times quickly, until the TV says you are now a developer. It is the last item, with a long code under it; not the item with a short number such as 14 under it.
Turn this on (it works over the network, despite its name):
If you also see this (newer TVs), turn it on too:
Keep the TV and this phone on the same Wi-Fi network.
Searching your Wi-Fi. Tap your TV when it appears.
• Check that debugging is on (step 3).\n• Make sure both are on the same Wi-Fi.\n• Some routers hide devices from each other: type the TV’s address instead.
On the TV: Settings › Network › your Wi-Fi. For Wireless debugging, add the port it shows, like 192.168.1.20:41234.
This phone isn’t on Wi-Fi. Connect to the same network as the TV, then try again.
Looking for an open debugging port on %1$s. This takes about 15 seconds.
A message appears on the TV:
Wireless debugging needs a one-time code from the TV.
Type the six-digit code it shows
Waiting for the pairing dialog on the TV…
Pairing port (after the colon on the TV)
Make sure it is the TV you mean before you start.
It has version %1$s, which becomes %2$s. Its settings and saved recitations stay.
Awan TV is up to date on it
It has %1$s, the version this installer carries. Set up again puts the service, permissions and screensaver right in seconds, without installing again.
It has %1$s, newer than the %2$s this installer carries. Get the latest installer from github.com/OmarGHub/AwanTV/releases
Awan TV %1$s · newer than this installer
Keep this screen open. It takes a few seconds.
Awan TV %1$s on “%2$s” is set up again.
Awan TV %1$s · keep this screen open. It takes a minute or two.
Keep this screen open. It takes a minute or two.
Awan TV sent to the TV
Another copy of Awan TV is on the TV

It was signed with a different key (a self-built or older copy), so it can’t be updated in place. Removing it also removes its settings and saved recitations. To keep the settings, cancel and export them first with the computer tools (AwanTV-settings). Remove it and install this one?
The TV has a newer Awan TV than this installer carries. Get the latest installer from the releases page: github.com/OmarGHub/AwanTV/releases
Awan TV is on your TV
Awan TV %1$s is installed and set up on “%2$s”.
Awan TV is installed and set up on “%1$s”.
Awan TV is on the TV, but a step marked in red didn’t finish. Run the installer again to retry it.
Press Home on the remote: Awan TV opens over the TV’s home screen.
On its first start it suggests the TV’s location: confirm it or choose another, and the times, the adhan and the screensaver follow it.
You can turn off USB debugging and Wireless debugging on the TV now. To update Awan TV later, turn debugging back on and open the new installer, from github.com/OmarGHub/AwanTV/releases
The TV didn’t allow this phone. Try again and choose Allow on the TV.
No debugging port is open on %1$s.
Pairing didn’t work (%1$s). Open the pairing dialog on the TV again; it shows a new code each time.
Awan TV needs Android 8 or later on the TV.
• The TV is on and awake.\n• Debugging is on in Developer options.\n• The TV and this phone are on the same Wi-Fi.
Awan TV is on the TV, but a step marked in red didn’t finish. Try it again, or continue and come back to it later.
Already in place on the TV
Set, but the TV doesn’t show it
